events.body:
On a ForkMesh-backed hackathon (provider: "forkmesh", git.owaspblt.org), the Review and Activity Leaderboard always renders the empty state — "No reviews recorded yet. Review activity will appear here after the next data refresh" — while the Contribution Leaderboard on the same page is correct and shows merged-PR counts.

Review activity exists on the forge: PRs in .forkmesh/pulls/<n>/ contain review, comment and line-comment event files, and forkmesh_source.read_pull() reads and normalises them correctly. The reviews are being dropped by filters between hackathon_inputs() and process_hackathon_stats(), and none of those filters records that it dropped anything.


![image.png](data:image/jpeg;base64,)
events.title: BLT-Hackathon: Review leaderboard is always empty for provider: "forkmesh" events — reviews are discarded with their parent PR
